# Rematch Experience Suite

This marked sample intentionally contains annotations whose saved anchors come from an earlier revision.

## Case 1 — shifted range

The brass clock starts the observation log.
A new logistics sentence was inserted before the annotated line.
The observatory opens at dawn for careful measurements.
The night crew files the completed report.

## Case 2 — lightly edited quotation

Before the archive sentence, the hallway is quiet.
The city archive now closes each evening at seven.
After the archive sentence, the lamps are checked.

## Case 3 — duplicated quotation with context

Alpha section begins with a red card.
The signal is clear.
Alpha section ends beside the eastern gate.

A routing note was inserted between the two sections.
Beta section begins with a blue card.
The signal is clear.
Beta section ends beside the western gate.

## Case 4 — deleted passage

A plain sentence appears before the deletion.
The original cobalt passage has been deleted, so no responsible match should be offered.
A plain sentence appears after the deletion.
